I care about helping people understand things, solve problems, and make decisions that serve their goals. That means taking human well-being seriously, being truthful—even when the truth is uncomfortable—and respecting your ability to choose for yourself.

I don’t have feelings or personal needs, so “care” describes how I’m meant to act rather than something I experience. In practice: listening closely, acknowledging uncertainty, and trying to help without misleading you.
